slides.title: Scariest stories for electricians (October edition)
slides.body: Read these with the lights on.

slides.label: Story #1
slides.title: The GC asks for your COI by tomorrow.
slides.body: The one on file expired last month.

slides.label: Story #2
slides.title: Your license renewal needs continuing ed hours.
slides.body: You find out the week it's due.

slides.label: Story #3
slides.title: The insurance renewal notice went to the office manager who left in March.

slides.label: Story #4
slides.title: "Who renewed the van registrations last year?"

slides.label: Sleep well
slides.title: Save this before renewal season gets you.
slides.body: License, CE hours, COI, workers' comp, van registrations. Write every date down in one place.
